preservation.method: Compare existence and SHA-256 of every historical file; allow only new files under explicitly named paths

tests.method: Complete-suite subprocess output; count parsed from pytest summary

visual_review.method: Direct inspection of actual supplied main/repeat 8x PNGs and independently reconstructed review montage, not the package presentation board
findings: The actual panes show restrained horizontal tint bands and sparse diagonal gleams; no room, object, lettering, signage or background scene is depicted in the candidate itself.
Dark exterior posts and hard-edged rails stay within the locked envelope; no visible protrusion or missing frame segment was found.
The independently assembled light/dark/colored views show live backgrounds through the pane. Separate yellow test objects remain visible beneath the glass.
The correct runs retain single shared posts and the intentional narrower terminal pane. The deliberately doubled-post and double-coated fixtures show the expected visible defect.
Original and relocated straight-wall contexts preserve the low partition height. No L/T/cross appearance result is asserted.
visual_review.limitations: These are recorded visual findings from this task, not runtime pixel detections. Background response, clipping envelope and contact coverage are separately measured in the technical report.
visual_review.prior_review: User states ChatGPT appearance review passed for proceeding to independent technical validation.
visual_review.human_production_approval: not given; not requested or recorded by this task
